rulesText: Each player controls a hero and a 16-card deck the server deals at random: two Major Arcana and fourteen minor cards. Some cards come reversed — a reversed card has a different effect, not a weaker one.
Before the first turn you may replace up to 3 cards of your starting hand once.

At the start of your turn your mana refills (it grows by one each turn, up to 7), you draw a card and effects like Burn and Regeneration take hold. With an empty deck you take growing fatigue damage instead of drawing.
On your turn, play cards, use your hero's ability once, fire the ultimate when it is charged, then end the turn. Each card you play adds a charge to the ultimate.
Swords deal physical damage, crits and counters. Cups heal and drain. Wands deal magic damage over time and empower the next card. Pentacles give armor, wards and mana. Major Arcana bend the rules.
Armor absorbs damage before health. A turn lasts {{turn}} seconds; letting the timer run out three turns in a row loses the match.
If you lose connection, the match waits {{reconnect}} seconds for you to return. Bring the enemy hero to zero health to win.
